name: Ca ro kho to
summary: Cá rô kho tộ is climbing perch cooked in a clay pot, one of the garden plates at Mỹ Khánh. Eat it at midday with the orchard visit.
howToEat: At the garden village, at midday.
where: Làng du lịch Mỹ Khánh, 335 Lộ Vòng Cung.
